name: @careerrat/desktop
description: CareerRat desktop app for macOS and Windows.
author: CodesWhat

scripts.smoke: npm --prefix ../.. run app:build && npm run stage && node scripts/brand-dev-app.mjs && electron . --smoke
scripts.dist:local: npm --prefix ../.. run app:build && npm run stage && npm run package:mac
scripts.dist: npm run dist:local && npm run release:dmg && npm run verify:release && npm run verify:packaged
scripts.release: npm run dist && npm run release:upload
